title: Project Infinity
tagline: Infinity Portal of NFTs, create NFTs within NFTs to traverse through different portals.
description: This project forms a portal of collective NFTs allowing users to mint blocks of NFTs within each portal to create a mosaic of NFTs that form an entire whole. The portals are designed such that one can link NFTs within NFTs to jump from one portal to another, providing a mechanism for one to traverse through endless possibilities and creations through an infinity of NFTs.
how_its_made: This project uses NFT Storage to store data on the IPFS and Filecoin network. We used Scaffold-ETH to bootstrap the frontend and backend to build on Ethereum. Thanks to Protocol Labs, this allowed for easy storage and retrieval of data. Also Scaffold-ETH allowed for rapid setup of a Web3 development environment.
